meta_title: Lee Bates Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Derby
meta_description: Lee Bates Plumbing offers emergency plumbing repairs, boiler servicing, and installations across Derby. Fast response times. Call 07976 602013 today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am in Derby? We're out within the hour, any day, any time. No faffing.
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to planned boiler replacements — we handle it all, fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Burst pipes, flooding, frozen pipes? We're available 24/7 and aim to reach you within 30 minutes across Derby. No premium pricing for nights or weekends.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler services keep your heating running smoothly and extend its lifespan. We diagnose faults quickly and carry parts on the van for most repairs same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New Worcester or Baxi boiler fitted with full commissioning and warranty. We'll handle the paperwork and disposal of your old unit.

services.title: Leaks & Radiator Repairs
services.desc: Leaking radiators, pipework damage, or dodgy connections? We'll trace the source and fix it properly, plus test the system under pressure before we leave.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full heating system overhauls, from pipework to controls. We design systems to your home's size and run through everything before we finish.

services.title: Unblocking & Drain Cleaning
services.desc: Blocked toilets, sinks, or drains cleared quickly. We use rodding and high-pressure jetting to clear the blockage and identify any underlying damage.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated being overcharged for simple jobs.
about_para_1: Lee Bates Plumbing was founded 18 years ago on a simple idea: turn up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price. We're a small family-run outfit based in Littleover, serving Derby and surrounding areas. Gas Safe Registered and insured for all domestic and light commercial work.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on doing what we say we'll do. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals — people know we won't disappear mid-job or hit them with surprise bills. We carry most parts on the van, so we can often solve your problem in one visit.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Lee Bates

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe just before Christmas. Called Lee on the Friday and he was round within an hour. Fixed it properly, no messing about, and didn't charge the earth. Exactly what you want at that time of year. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a Sunday morning. Lee got here at lunchtime, diagnosed a faulty pump, had a replacement fitted and tested by mid-afternoon. Very professional, explained everything clearly. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Been using Lee for about five years now. Annual service on the boiler, couple of radiator adjustments over the years. Always reliable, fair pricing, and he knows the house inside out. That's worth a lot.
reviews.author: David M.
